# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_RIBBON_CONFLUENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap-up that fails to hold above VWAP within the first 15 minutes, combined with bearish EMA ribbon alignment (8 < 21 < 34), signals institutional short-covering exhaustion and sets up a mean-reversion short opportunity. This edge exists because gap-ups often attract retail FOMO and algorithmic momentum ignition, but when the move lacks follow-through volume and fails key intraday support (VWAP) while showing bearish multi-timeframe alignment, smart money fades the move for a reversion to the volume-weighted average price.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When (1) today's opening price gaps up >0.2% from prior session's close, (2) price falls below VWAP within the first 15 minutes of trading (9:30-9:45 ET), and (3) the 8/21/34 EMA ribbon is stacked bearish (8 EMA < 21 EMA < 34 EMA) at the time of VWAP breach, enter short at the close of the 5-minute bar that first closes below VWAP after the gap.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the opening gap high (or intraday high if higher). Profit target 1 at 1R (risk-reward = 1). Runner trail: 10% trailing stop from the high-water mark after TP1 hit. Time-based exit: 15:50 ET hard stop for any remaining position.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (per OP-20 disclosure 1).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample would be all gap-up days >0.2% in 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 (~120 days). Selection method: look for gap-up >0.2% at open, then VWAP breach within first 15 min, then bearish ribbon. Overfit risk: high due to multiple conditions; requires walk-forward validation to avoid curve-fitting to specific gap-fade episodes.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed yet).
